summary: First run. Backend: 24 pytest tests, 22 passed. All requested features work: auth, role checks, products CRUD, sales (tunai change, too-little-cash 400, qris), modal/expense, transaction filters, and the daily report formula. The 2 failures are validation gaps that let money leak: the server trusts the price sent by the client, and it accepts negative qty. Frontend (390x844): login for both roles, wrong-password error, Kasir chips and search, add to cart, cart bar to Pesanan, qty +/- buttons, pm-tunai/qris/transfer, pay button disabled when cash is too little, quick-50000, receipt sheet (Cetak Struk / Bagikan / Lewati, no auto-print), Lewati returns to the menu with the cart cleared, all drawer screens, Produk add, Modal expense, audit filters, logout, kasir drawer showing only Kasir, and Riwayat all PASS. Problems found: no auth/role route guard (a logged-out or kasir user can deep-link to /produk etc.), the daily report uses UTC day boundaries while the client sends a local WIB date, the Laporan Audit list renders in the middle of the screen, the Kasir product list does not refresh on focus, and print/share/export on web give no visible feedback. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues: none.

critical.issue: The server trusts the price and cost sent by the client. A sale with price=1 for a Rp10.000 product is accepted, giving subtotal 1. This is a money-leak hole in an app meant to stop leaks. Fetch price and cost from db.products by product_id.
Negative or zero qty is accepted (qty=-3 returns 200). This gives a negative subtotal and increases stock. No Field(gt=0) on qty, price or paid_amount.

The day window is built in UTC (server.py:349-355). The frontend sends a local date (format.ts todayISO). In WIB (UTC+7), sales made 00:00-07:00 are counted in the previous day, so daily totals are wrong. Use the Asia/Jakarta timezone or accept a tz offset.

minor.issue: amount has no gt=0 check, so negative or zero modal/expense amounts are accepted.
No stock check: stock can go negative.
Any cashier can read HPP, profit, and owner modal/expense entries. Consider making the reports owner-only.
Hard delete: no audit trail, stock is not restored, and a missing id gives 200 instead of 404. Weak for an audit app.
Reads every transaction (to_list(5000)) and filters in Python. Use a Mongo created_at range query.

ui_bugs.issue: The horizontal chips ScrollView has no flexGrow:0, so on web it grows vertically and pushes the list to the middle of the screen (large empty gap). Fix: style={{flexGrow:0}} on the ScrollView at laporan-audit.tsx:51.
Uses useEffect instead of useFocusEffect (index.tsx:43). Products added in Produk, and stock changes, do not show in Kasir until pull-to-refresh.

ui_bugs.component: ReceiptSheet share/print and Laporan Harian export
ui_bugs.issue: On web, Bagikan and export do nothing visible. Errors are swallowed by an empty catch and Sharing is unavailable on web. Add a fallback or a toast. Native builds need manual verification.
produk-del and audit-del delete immediately with no confirmation.

integration_issues.issue: No guard in _layout. Opening /produk while logged out renders the screen (APIs return 401 and the list shows 'Belum ada produk'). A kasir can open /produk, /laporan-harian, /laporan-audit and /modal directly. There is no 401 handling to redirect to login when the token expires.

issues: The cart step buttons (minus, plus, trash) are 32x32, under the 44pt minimum.
The trash (remove) button has no testID.
The bell icon, the 'PAKET HEMAT SIANG' promo card (hardcoded Rp 18.000) and 'Lihat semua' do nothing when tapped.
Stock is not shown and out-of-stock products can still be added.
Back buttons are 36px with no testID.
Laporan Harian only shows today; there is no date picker.

action_items: POST /api/sales: load price and cost from the DB by product_id and ignore the client values. Validate qty>0 and paid_amount>=0 with Pydantic Field(gt=0/ge=0).
Daily report: compute the day window in Asia/Jakarta (UTC+7), or have the frontend send a tz offset.
Add an auth guard (redirect to /login when there is no user) and an owner-only guard for /produk, /modal, /laporan-*, /pengaturan. Handle 401 globally in api.ts.
laporan-audit.tsx:51: add style={{flexGrow:0}} to the horizontal ScrollView.
Kasir index.tsx: reload products with useFocusEffect.
Add confirm dialogs before deleting products or transactions. Consider soft-delete and restoring stock for transaction deletes.
Give feedback or a web fallback for share/export failures. Enlarge cart step buttons to 44px.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_sale trusts client-supplied SaleItem.price/cost: the core bookkeeping integrity flaw.
Pydantic models have no numeric constraints (ProductIn price/stock, SaleItem qty, ModalIn amount).
Empty catch blocks throughout (index.tsx load, produk.tsx del, laporan-audit load/del, ReceiptSheet print/share) hide errors from the user.
laporan-harian exportCsv actually exports a PDF; the name is misleading.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; issues are guard, layout and refresh)

seed_data_creation: Pytest TEST_* products, transactions and categories were cleaned up, as were the UI TEST_UI Bakso product and TEST_UI gas expense. 3 UI-test sales by owner remain in the DB (Rp36.000 tunai, Rp12.000 qris, Rp12.000 transfer).
